{{Quote|Star Tours announces another of our exciting action-adventure tours. Join us on the Trek to Tatooine. Start your visit with a trip to the Galactic Zoo. Then race over to the Mos Eisley Cantina, for cocktails with the galaxy's most outrageous characters. If adventure is your middle name, this is the tour for you: The Trek to Tatooine! StarSpeeder service begins soon. Reservations are limited, so call your travel agent or Star Tours today.|Vid-screen announcer|<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>}}
'''Trek to Tatooine''' was an "action-adventure" tour package offered by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The tour included a flight to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and visits to the desert planet's [[Galactic Zoo]] and [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], at the time working on preparations for the launch of the [[StarSpeeder 3000]] [[Transport 22]] when seeing the advertisement, both agreed that they did not wish to return to Tatooine, although C-3PO did mention that it was "one tour Star Tours can keep" as he didn't want another case of dust contamination.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trek to Tatooine appeared in the form of a "commercial" played on the large video screen in the queue of the original version of [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="YouTube queue video">{{YouTube|video=f7a91G8k9Nk|text=Trek To Tatooine|channel=channel/UCVsNHJYZ3Nf4YUnlhiK6NMQ|name=WDWScottsmitty}}</ref>
